objective: The bridge's « Set up » waits for the agents instead of opening a terminal and leaving its checkboxes disabled.
summary: The bridge asks for the agents as soon as it opens (not for a set-up project), « Set up » is disabled with « Looking for the agents on this machine… » until they come, and only a failed detection opens init in a terminal, without leaving the bridge « running ». Tests (webview 164, extension 101), typecheck, lint and format pass. Not committed, not released.
